CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Loan_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Term_Months__c), Term_Months__c <= 0), NULL, IF(OR(ISBLANK(Interest_Rate__c), Interest_Rate__c = 0), Loan_Amount__c / Term_Months__c, Loan_Amount__c * (Interest_Rate__c / 12) / (1 - 1 / ((1 + Interest_Rate__c / 12) ^ Term_Months__c))))
CustomField.label: Monthly Payment
